CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation linking to identified content present.

COD.rationale: Content (color-position entries) plus explicit origin/representation metadata provide identification, organization/access description and separate status labeling for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition linked to the content's presentation or access is present.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify color-labelled position sets for named referents and times.

D.rationale: Content identification (color-position) is presented alongside a separate origin/representation status for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: Explicit origin/representation metadata describe how contents are represented or accessed (kinds like copied_prior_record, history_estimate).
